title: Longest Substring with At Most K Distinct Characters
description: Generalize the two-distinct problem to k distinct characters using a sliding window.

data.text: Given a string `s` and an integer `k`, return the length of the longest substring that contains at most `k` distinct characters.

data.title: Check every window O(n^2)
Grow-shrink O(n)
What improved?
data.text: The dictionary now tracks counts for up to `k` characters. Shrinking only happens when we exceed `k`, giving a single-pass O(n) solution.
